polar.square.$comment: Speed fraction by angle off the wind: index i is i * stepDeg, 0 = head to wind, 180 = running. Square rig peaks on a broad reach. Tuned for play over strict realism (PRD: fun wins): no drive inside ~30 deg, and the best upwind course (about 50 deg off) makes good ~0.47 of top speed, so beating to windward is slower than reaching but never a chore.

polar.fore_aft.$comment: Fore-and-aft rig (sloops): points higher than square rig, with drive past 12 deg and the best upwind course near 36 deg off, but slower running dead downwind where the big mainsail blankets the jib.
